caseName: Luckenbach Steamship Co. v. Franchise Tax Board
caseNameFull: LUCKENBACH STEAMSHIP CO., INC. v. FRANCHISE TAX BOARD OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Hart H. Spiegel and John Hays for appellant., Stanley Mosk, Attorney General of California, James E. Sabine, Assistant Attorney General, and Ernest P. Goodman and John J. Klee, Jr., Deputy Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
